title: Droste Spiral Zoom
blurb: An endless Escher Print Gallery zoom: a neon picture that contains itself, bent by the complex log-spiral map so the nested copies join into spiral arms.
controls: Drag to move the vanishing point, scroll to scrub the zoom, sliders for scale ratio, spiral arms, copies, zoom speed, color cycle and glow; picture menu and Reseed for new colors; H hides UI, R records
